brief: A sovereign Cosmos chain that converts its native asset, NOAH, into a family of fiat-tracking currencies, with three funds standing behind them. Trust comes from disclosure and bounded authority, not from a promise of growth.
criteria: Success: reads at 16 px and in 1-bit on a Ledger, holds in one colour, stands apart from blue crypto marks, and carries one idea.

concepts.name: Whole
concepts.idea: The peak above the waterline and its reflection in the hull make one diamond: two halves, one whole.
rationale: Unity: the half above the water and the half held within are the same shape, and the eye completes the diamond
Built from 45 degrees and one circle: the peak and its mirror are identical, the hull is a half-disc
Keeps the Ledger Hull outline; a small drawing with a wider waterline carries it to 16 px and 1-bit
Navy from the Ledger listing, with clay and tide accents so it stands apart from blue crypto marks

recommendation: Use the horizontal lockup by default, the symbol alone at icon sizes, and the small drawing at 24 px and below.
next_steps: Trademark search for the name and the mark
Proof navy and clay against a physical Pantone guide
Move the Ledger app glyphs to the new mark
